title: Harriet Tubman Bicentennial Commemorative Coin Act
official_summary:
Harriet Tubman Bicentennial Commemorative Coin Act

This bill directs the Department of the Treasury to mint and issue 50,000 $5 gold coins, 400,000 $1 silver coins, and 750,000 half-dollar clad coins emblematic of the legacy of Harriet Tubman as an abolitionist.

The Secretary may issue coins under this bill only during the period of January 1, 2024, through December 31, 2024.

All surcharges received by Treasury from the sale of such coins must be paid equally to the National Underground Railroad Freedom Center in Cincinnati, Ohio, and The Harriet Tubman Home, Inc. in Auburn, New York, for the purpose of accomplishing and advancing their missions.

summary.headline: A 2022 law directed the Treasury to mint Harriet Tubman commemorative coins for sale during 2024, with proceeds going to two organizations.
summary.what_it_does: The law tells the Treasury Department to make and issue 50,000 gold $5 coins, 400,000 silver $1 coins, and 750,000 half-dollar coins that honor Harriet Tubman as an abolitionist. The coins could only be issued between January 1, 2024, and December 31, 2024. The extra amount paid above the coins' face value, called surcharges, must be split equally between the National Underground Railroad Freedom Center in Cincinnati, Ohio, and The Harriet Tubman Home, Inc. in Auburn, New York.

who_it_affects.group: People who buy the commemorative coins
who_it_affects.how: They could purchase the coins at a price that includes a surcharge, but only during the 2024 sales period.
They had the chance to buy a limited run of coins made in gold, silver, and clad metal to mark Harriet Tubman's legacy.

who_it_affects.group: The National Underground Railroad Freedom Center in Cincinnati, Ohio
who_it_affects.how: It receives half of the surcharge money from coin sales to use for its mission.

who_it_affects.group: The Harriet Tubman Home, Inc. in Auburn, New York
who_it_affects.how: It receives half of the surcharge money from coin sales to use for its mission.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The coins could be issued only from January 1, 2024, through December 31, 2024.
